changelog:
china-bankcard 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Provides offline parsing and validation of Chinese bank card numbers.
- Identifies issuing bank (top 20), card type (debit/credit), card organization (UnionPay/Visa/MasterCard/AmEx/JCB), and card length.
- Validates Luhn checksum to check card number validity.
- No network access or API key required; fully offline and privacy-friendly.
- Masks card numbers in output for security.
